title: Live sync between two windows, then search past work
about: One workspace open in two windows, then the agent recalls earlier work.

steps.say: A Houston house before a storm.
A first run puts the workspace in MongoDB.
A read-only link opens the same workspace in a second window.

else.say: No share links on the file store: the same workspace in a second window.

steps.say: A run here arrives in the other window as it happens: a change stream.

steps.text: What did I find about flooding before? Pick up where I left off.
steps.say: The agent searches this person's past workspaces with Atlas Search.

else.say: Past work needs the MongoDB store; this server keeps workspaces in files.
